title: 第10章 姑姑一家
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 青藤市，南区，飞鸟与鱼餐厅。中午11点10分，许牧在服务员的引领下，来到了姑姑在消息里说的包厢门前。他伸手握住门把手，轻轻扭动，推门走了进去。包厢房间内开阔明亮，餐桌上摆着几道家常菜，烟火气十足，许牧发现一大半都是自已喜欢的菜系。没想到七年没见，姑姑还记得我喜欢吃的菜……藏在许牧心底最柔软的地方被触动。包厢房间内的姑姑一家听到声音，同时看向门口，看见了身形挺拔，面带微笑的许牧。“小牧来啦，快来坐！”姑姑许玉兰率先起身，笑着招呼道，眉眼间满是欣慰。姑父宋建军也和煦地笑着招手：“大侄子，你可算来了！”旁边的妹妹宋玥萌正托着腮，看到他进来，立刻矜持地坐直身体，碧绿眼眸一亮，眉眼弯弯地望着他。她今年刚好18岁，面容清秀，眉眼间还带着少女的青涩，直到许牧走到她身旁空位坐下，她才藏起目光，小声喊了句：“哥，好久不见”。许牧眯着眼睛，轻轻揉了揉她的脑袋，“好久不见，萌萌。记得上次见你才这么高……”许牧边说边用手量出一米左右的高度。姑姑许玉兰在一旁逗趣道：“这孩子，打小就喜欢黏着你和你玩，听说要来青藤市见你，昨晚估计开心得一宿没睡，今天在车上睡了一路。结果你看看，见到你反而泄气了。”“哎呀，妈，我哪有……”宋玥萌耳朵微微泛红，嘴硬地反驳道。许牧摇头笑了笑，忙替妹妹圆场：“毕竟我们7年没见了，都从小屁孩长大成人，完全变了样，彼此之间还有点陌生。”闻言，宋玥萌快速点了点头，连忙附和道：“嗯嗯，就是这样。”几人边吃菜边寒暄，期间姑姑不停给许牧夹菜，关切地问起他的学业和兼职，语气里满是心疼：“你这孩子，一个人在青藤市不容易，别总委屈自已。”姑父也跟着补充道：“对，有什么困难就跟我们说，别硬扛。”许牧心里一暖，这是他父母离世后，唯一能感受到的亲情暖意，他轻声应着：“我知道，姑姑姑父你们放心，我一切都好。”一旁的宋玥萌也跟着轻轻点头，小声关心道：“哥，这些年你一定很苦，不过以后我也在青藤了，我会陪着你的。”说话时，她微微低着头，声音柔软却透着坚定。寒暄过后，气氛渐渐沉静下来，姑姑放下筷子，神色变得认真起来，看向许牧：“小牧，这次我们来青藤市，除了送萌萌来上学，还有一件重要的事想拜托你。”许牧心里一动，坐直身体道：“姑姑，您说，只要我能做到，一定帮。”“是这样……” 姑姑叹了口气：“我和你姑父的工作调动下来了，要去国外两年，没法带着萌萌一起去。萌萌刚考上青藤大学，性子腼腆，又有点社恐，一个人在学校我们不放心，想着你也在青藤市，能不能麻烦你，这两年多照看着点她？”姑父也跟着点头，语气诚恳：“萌萌年纪小，没离开过家，以后她在学校有什么事，或者生活上有麻烦，就麻烦你多费心了。”许牧怔了一下，他原本只是担心妹妹在学校遇到失控者的危险，没想到姑姑姑父会把妹妹全权托付给他。许牧不由转头看向妹妹，发现她正乖巧端坐，期待又忐忑地望着自已，目光相撞后又忙低下脑袋。一瞬间，许牧觉得有一种名为责任的无形事物，沉甸甸地压在了肩膀上。不过，即使姑姑他们不去国外，他这四年也会照顾萌萌。许牧转念一想，觉得差别也不大，无非就是节假日的时候，妹妹从回家过节变成来他家过节。思考过后，他当即点头回答道：“姑姑姑父，你们放心，我会照顾好萌萌。”听到这话，宋玥萌快速抬起脑袋，碧绿眼眸光采灵动，看着许牧道：“哥，别担心，我会很乖的，而且我还可以给你做好吃的。”“好啊，那我们以后互相关照？”许牧歪了一下脑袋，微笑伸出手掌。“嗯嗯，互相关照！”宋玥萌雀跃回道，同时抬起略显小巧的手掌握住许牧。看见这一幕，宋建军和许玉兰都颇感欣慰，不约而同地笑了起来。半个小时后，这顿饭已然进入尾声，姑父宋建军看了看时间，说道：“小牧，我和你姑姑今天下午就要赶回去，明天就出发去国外了，等青藤大学开学，就麻烦你带萌萌去报到了。”姑姑也嘱咐道：“我们给萌萌定了10天的酒店，就在你家小区对面，方便这几天你们见面，你们都要照顾好自已，注意安全。”许牧认真点头道：“好的，那这几天我带萌萌出去转转，顺便熟悉一下青藤市。”这时，宋玥萌轻轻扯了扯许牧的衣角，询问道：“哥，过几天你能陪我去西郊的森林广场吗？”顿了顿，她补充道：“我好朋友林溪特别喜欢肖凡，她抢了好多肖凡的演唱会门票，非拉着我和其他朋友陪她一起去。”又是肖凡……许牧的心顿时一沉，没想到担心的事情这么快就来了，所幸事情不是特别紧急，还有斡旋的余地。他几乎可以肯定，那场演唱会上，一定有被污染的失控者，就像李桃潜意识里的画面一样，萌萌去了，无异于羊入虎口。但他不能直接说“不能去，那里有怪物”，他不能暴露超凡世界的秘密，更不能让姑姑姑父和萌萌陷入恐慌。他决定暂时假装答应下来，不表现出异常，等下午问过陆剑星和风华瑾他们，看他们这些“专业人士”有什么建议。许牧冷静下来，脸上不动声色，语气温和道：“好，如果有时间，到时候我会陪你们过去。”无论如何，到时候我肯定不会放你过去……他于心里无声补充道。这时，许牧的手机震动了一下，是陈丧发来的消息：“下午3点前，东区警署分局。”许牧看了一眼消息，抬头说道：“姑姑姑父，那我们先送萌萌去酒店吧，我下午还有点事情，忙完之后就去找萌萌。”闻言，姑姑眉头微蹙，略带责怪道：“你这孩子，还说自已不辛苦，又是兼职的事吧？”许牧嘿嘿一笑，摸了摸鼻子说道：“姑姑，没事，年轻人就得多折腾，您放心，这个兼职绝对不累。”“就你滑舌。”几人一边融洽聊着天，一边离开了餐厅。
content_en: Ivy City, South District, Bird and Fish Restaurant.At 11:10 noon, Xu Mu, led by the waiter, arrived at the door of the box that his aunt had mentioned in the message.He reached out and grasped the door handle, twisted it slightly, pushed the door open and walked in.The private room was open and bright, and there were several home-cooked dishes on the dining table. It was full of fireworks. Xu Mu found that most of them were his favorite cuisines.Unexpectedly, after seven years of not seeing each other, my aunt still remembered my favorite dishes... The softest place in Xu Mu's heart was touched.The aunt's family in the private room heard the sound and looked at the door at the same time, seeing Xu Mu who was tall and smiling."Xiao Mu is here, come and sit down!" Aunt Xu Yulan stood up first and greeted with a smile, her eyes full of relief.Uncle Song Jianjun also smiled warmly and waved: "Nephew, you're finally here!" The sister Song Yuemeng next to her was holding her chin. When she saw him coming in, she immediately sat upright and reservedly, her green eyes brightened and she looked at him with curved eyebrows.She was just 18 years old this year, with a delicate face and the youthfulness of a girl in her eyebrows. It wasn't until Xu Mu came to sit down in the empty seat next to her that she hid her gaze and whispered: "Brother, long time no see."Xu Mu squinted his eyes and gently rubbed her head, "Long time no see, Mengmeng. I remember you were this tall last time I saw you..." Xu Mu said as he measured the height of about one meter with his hands.Aunt Xu Yulan said jokingly: "This kid has liked to stick to you and play with you since he was a child. I heard that he was coming to Ivy City to see you. I was so happy that I didn't sleep all night last night. I slept in the car all the way today. But look, I feel discouraged when I see you." "Oh, Mom, how could I..." Song Yuemeng's ears turned slightly red and she retorted sternly.Xu Mu shook his head and smiled, and hurriedly smoothed things over for his sister: "After all, we haven't seen each other for seven years. We have grown up from little kids and are completely different. We are still a bit strange to each other." Hearing this, Song Yuemeng nodded quickly and agreed quickly: "Yeah, yeah,That's it." The group of people chatted while eating. During this period, my aunt kept picking up food for Xu Mu and asked about his studies and part-time job with concern. Her tone was full of heartache: "It's not easy for you kid to be alone in Qingteng City.Don't always feel sorry for yourself."Then he added: "Yes, if you have any difficulties, just tell us and don't bear it." Xu Mu felt warm in his heart. This was the only warmth of family affection that he could feel after his parents passed away. He responded softly: "I know, aunt and uncle, don't worry, I will give you everything."It's all good." Song Yuemeng on the side also nodded slightly and whispered in concern: "Brother, you must have been suffering these years, but I will be with you in the future." When she spoke, she lowered her head slightly, her voice soft but firm.After the greetings, the atmosphere gradually calmed down. Aunt put down her chopsticks, her expression became serious, and she looked at Xu Mu: "Xiao Mu, this time we come to Qingteng City, in addition to sending Mengmeng to school, there is another important thing I want to ask you." Xu Mu's heart moved, he sat up straight and said: "Aunt, you said, as long as I can do it, I will definitely help." "That's it..."The aunt sighed: "Your uncle and I have been transferred from work. We are going abroad for two years. We cannot take Mengmeng with us. Mengmeng has just been admitted to Ivy League University. She is shy and a bit socially anxious. We are worried about being alone in school. I think you are also in Ivy City. Can I trouble you to take care of her in the past two years?"The father also nodded and said in a sincere tone: "Mengmeng is young and has never left home. If she encounters problems in school or has trouble in her life in the future, please worry about it." Xu Mu was startled for a moment. He was originally worried that his sister would encounter the danger of someone out of control at school, but he did not expect that his aunt and uncle would entrust his sister to him.Xu Mu couldn't help turning his head to look at his sister, and found that she was sitting obediently, looking at him expectantly and anxiously, and then quickly lowered her head after their eyes met.For a moment, Xu Mu felt that there was an invisible thing called responsibility, weighing heavily on his shoulders.However, even if his aunt and the others don't go abroad, he will still take care of Mengmeng in the past four years.Xu Mu thought about it and realized that the difference was not big. It was just that during the holidays, his sister changed from going home to celebrate the holidays to coming to his house to celebrate the holidays.After thinking about it, he immediately nodded and replied: "Aunt and uncle, don't worry, I will take good care of Mengmeng." Hearing this, Song Yuemeng quickly raised her head, her green eyes were bright, and she looked at Xu Mu and said, "Brother, don't worry, I will be very good, and I can also make delicious food for you." "Okay, then we will take care of each other in the future?" Xu Mu tilted his head, smiled and extended his palm."Yeah, let's take care of each other!" Song Yuemeng replied happily, and at the same time raised her slightly small palm to hold Xu Mu.Seeing this scene, Song Jianjun and Xu Yulan were both very pleased and laughed in unison.Half an hour later, the meal had come to an end. His uncle Song Jianjun looked at the time and said, "Xiao Mu, your aunt and I are going back this afternoon and will leave for abroad tomorrow. When Ivy League University starts, I will trouble you to take Mengmeng to register."My aunt also told me: "We have booked a hotel for Mengmeng for 10 days. It is right opposite your community. It is convenient for you to meet in the past few days.You must take care of yourself and pay attention to safety." Xu Mu nodded seriously and said: "Okay, then I will take Mengmeng out in these few days.Let's go and get familiar with Ivy City." At this time, Song Yuemeng gently tugged at the corner of Xu Mu's clothes and asked, "Brother, can you accompany me to the Forest Square in the western suburbs in a few days?" After a pause, she added, "My good friend Lin Xi likes Xiao Fan very much., she grabbed a lot of Xiao Fan's concert tickets and had to drag me and other friends to accompany her."It's Xiao Fan again... Xu Mu's heart suddenly sank. He didn't expect that the worrying matter would come so soon. Fortunately, the matter was not particularly urgent and there was still room for mediation.He was almost certain that there must have been contaminated out-of-control people at that concert, just like the picture in Li Tao's subconscious. Mengmeng's disappearance was like a sheep entering a tiger's mouth.But he couldn't directly say "Can't go, there are monsters there", he couldn't expose the secrets of the extraordinary world, let alone put his aunt, uncle and Mengmeng into panic.He decided to pretend to agree for the time being and not show any abnormality. He asked Lu Jianxing and Feng Huajin in the afternoon to see what suggestions they, "professionals", had.Xu Mu calmed down, with a calm expression on his face, and said in a gentle tone: "Okay, if I have time, I will accompany you there then." No matter what, I will definitely not let you go there then... He added silently in his heart.At this time, Xu Mu's cell phone vibrated, and it was a message from Chen Sang: "Before 3 p.m., Eastern District Police Station Branch." Xu Mu glanced at the message, raised his head and said, "Auntie, let's take Mengmeng to the hotel first. I have something to do in the afternoon, so I will go find Mengmeng after I finish my work." Hearing this, her aunt frowned slightly., said slightly reproachfully: "You kid, you still say that you are not working hard, and it is a part-time job, right?" Xu Mu chuckled, touched his nose and said: "Aunt, it's okay, young people have to work hard, don't worry, this part-time job will definitely not be tiring." "It's just you who has a smooth tongue." They chatted harmoniously and left the restaurant.
